rationale: The instrument gapped down with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.72%, VIXY +3.38%) but has since settled into a tight 9-cent range, sitting almost exactly at session VWAP and mid-range with no follow-through in either direction. As a covered-call income ETF its realized intraday movement is structurally dampened, and with only five minutes of price discovery, no catalyst, and no momentum or rejection signal at the range edges, neither long nor short carries a measurable edge. Waiting for a decisive break of the opening range or sustained VWAP deviation offers better evidence to act on.
